description: What changed in StockMap's calls last night: how many stocks' calls changed band on the market map and the biggest of them, the calls graded last night (made 14 days earlier) with one line on why each was right or wrong, and when the next run starts. Each answer carries the not-advice line and the run date.
name: last_night

arrow.description: ▲ the call moved up the band order, ▼ down; none when the band it left is not known
arrow.title: Arrow

band_from.description: The band the stock's call left, when the feed records it
band_from.title: Band From

to.description: The band the stock's call moved to, as the map paints it
to.title: To

date.description: The day the call was made; it is graded 14 days later
date.title: Date

why.description: One line on why the call was right or wrong
why.title: Why

base_rate_pct.description: How often a random call on the same dates was right, over all stocks (a market number, not a score of these calls)
base_rate_pct.title: Base Rate Pct

chance.description: The base rate as one sentence, or None when there is none
chance.title: Chance

not_landed.description: True: tonight's run has not landed yet, so this is the previous run
not_landed.title: Not Landed

changed_on_map.description: Stocks whose call changed band on the map
changed_on_map.title: Changed On Map

changes.description: The biggest of them by market cap
changes.title: Changes

more_changes.description: The changes not listed; all of them are on /what-changed
more_changes.title: More Changes

not_advice.default: The model's track-recorded read, not financial advice.
not_advice.title: Not Advice

run.description: The run the night is from: the day it ran and the close it called from

run_in_flight.description: True: tonight's run has not landed yet, so this is the previous night (B2's name for run.not_landed)
run_in_flight.title: Run In Flight

title: Last night
